label: Umbrella review protocol
framework: JBI umbrella review guidance with PRIOR-informed overview reporting

items.requirement: Identify the document as an umbrella review protocol.
items.prompt: What is the umbrella review title and topic area?
items.helpText: Umbrella reviews synthesize existing systematic reviews or meta-analyses.
items.exampleResponse: Umbrella review protocol: effects of school-based nutrition interventions on child health outcomes.

items.requirement: Explain why an overview of reviews is needed.
items.prompt: Why is a review of existing systematic reviews more appropriate than a new primary-study review?
items.helpText: Mention evidence volume, overlapping reviews, discordant conclusions, or decision needs.
items.exampleResponse: Multiple systematic reviews report overlapping but discordant findings, creating uncertainty for guideline developers.

items.requirement: State the review question for systematic reviews.
items.prompt: What population, intervention/exposure, comparator, outcome, and review type will define eligibility?
items.helpText: The unit of inclusion is usually a systematic review, not each primary study.
items.exampleResponse: We will include systematic reviews of school nutrition interventions compared with usual practice for child health outcomes.

items.requirement: Specify eligible review products and overlap handling.
items.prompt: Which types of reviews are eligible, and how will overlapping primary studies be managed?
items.helpText: State whether rapid reviews, scoping reviews, narrative reviews, and primary studies are excluded.
items.exampleResponse: We will include systematic reviews with explicit searches and eligibility criteria; overlap will be assessed using citation matrices.

items.prompt: Which databases and review repositories will be searched for existing reviews?
items.helpText: Include sources such as Epistemonikos, Cochrane Library, MEDLINE, and discipline-specific databases.
items.exampleResponse: We will search Epistemonikos, Cochrane Library, MEDLINE, Embase, Campbell Library, and reference lists of included reviews.

items.requirement: Describe appraisal of included systematic reviews.
items.prompt: Which tool will assess review quality or methodological confidence?
items.helpText: AMSTAR 2 or JBI critical appraisal for systematic reviews are common choices.
items.exampleResponse: Two reviewers will use AMSTAR 2 to appraise included systematic reviews.

items.prompt: How will review findings, overlap, quality, and certainty be summarized?
items.helpText: Umbrella reviews usually avoid double-counting primary studies and may summarize evidence by outcome domain.
items.exampleResponse: We will summarize effect directions, overlap, AMSTAR 2 ratings, and certainty by outcome using structured tables.
